name: Dinar Super Wash
tagline: A clean you can see, a fragrance that stays.
taglineHi: सफ़ाई जो दिखे, ख़ुशबू जो महके।
description: Dinar Super Wash is a multi-action detergent powder for everyday family laundry. Its Keep-it-Clean enzymes break down tough stains, rich foam carries dirt out of the fabric, and the powder dissolves quickly, whether you wash by hand or in a machine.
It is gentle on fabrics and helps them keep their colour, rinses out with less residue, and leaves clothes fresh and fragrant. Whites come out brighter, wash after wash.

packBack.alt: Back of the Dinar detergent powder pack, showing the usage steps, best-before period, manufacturer and customer care details
